title: Prepare evidence-based renewal and expansion conversations for institutional Zedu accounts
description: Create an account review process for institutions approaching renewal or considering more cohorts. Distinct from free-plan upgrade prompts and product retention metrics: this addresses an existing institutional buying relationship. Deliver an aggregate account-health scorecard, review agenda, continuation/expansion/no-fit decision guide and two draft follow-up messages. Use only permissioned usage summaries, verified plan terms and customer-confirmed goals; provide synthetic examples until access is approved. Done when the team approves the process and each recommendation can be traced to customer outcomes, fit and unresolved blockers. Do not invent usage, promise discounts, change contracts or contact customers.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Institutional account-health scorecard and renewal conversation kit
acceptedWorkstreams.description: A process for institutional accounts approaching renewal or expansion. Deliverables: (1) an account-health scorecard using only permissioned usage summaries and verified plan terms — active cohorts, Buzz calls run, files shared, admin seats, support tickets; (2) a review agenda with entry/exit criteria; (3) a decision guide for continuation / expansion / no-fit; (4) two draft follow-up messages using only customer-confirmed goals. Synthetic examples used until access is approved. No invented usage, no discounts, no contract changes, no customer contact. Done when the team approves and every recommendation traces to customer outcomes, fit, and unresolved blockers.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Time each renewal review to the institution's budget and term calendar, not the contract date
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Schools, universities and bootcamps decide spending at fixed points (budget approval, term planning, cohort intake), often months before a contract ends. Approach: for each institution type, record when budget decisions are made and who signs, using public calendars and the "Map school terms and bootcamp start periods" goal's findings; then set the review meeting 6-8 weeks before that point. Done: a timing table per institution type with sources, the trigger rule for scheduling the review, and the reminder template. Measured: share of reviews held before the budget decision rather than after.
